notes.title: Clean Stack Demo - ASMR Update - OUT NOW !
notes.notes:
Trailer showcasing the most important additions 
[previewyoutube=YjIXPjlwIDw;full][/previewyoutube]

Clean Stack Demo - ASMR Update Changes & Improvements list 

Bug fixes:

 Fixed bug making the player softlock himself if he tries to trigger a dialogue in a transition
 Fixed player being able to take multiple potions at the same time
 Fixed Hard mode affecting the sandbox area
 Fixed some visuals bugs with the magnifying glass
 Fixed some visuals bugs with the preview of the content of each box in levels


Gameplay:

 Furniture boxes are no longer affected by the hard mode
 Magnifying glass animation is faster
 Removing access to that one thing
 Added a brand new dialogue


Visuals:

 Adding a effect from pressing the bin in the sandbox area
 Adding a effect for putting the mouse on playable levels in the level selector
 Adding a effect for putting the mouse on boxes/potions in the inventory levels



I hope I didn't forget any bugs, please let me know if you find any bugs to fix!
Thanks for reading 💖
